card.name: Linking words before a drug name
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, with, to, take) or a space before a number, placed right before a drug name or dose value in dosing and treatment instructions.

modes.label: Linking word before drug
modes.description: A preposition or verb right before the drug name is expected.
modes.example: The physician may wish to consider contacting a poison control center for up-to-date information on the management of overdosage<< with>> methylphenidate.

modes.label: Space before a dose number
modes.description: A blank space token just before a dose amount or age range.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly the Chinese, Korean and Vietnamese word for "this", so there is no clear output effect on English text.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words just before a drug name or dose is stated in label directions.
